chunks: TRULY WE REVEALED it on the Night of Determination.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Night of Decree (Laylat al-Qadr) in relation to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often interpreted alongside the concept of *Tanzil* (descent), emphasizing that the entire Quran was sent down to the lowest heaven in this single night, distinct from the gradual *Tanzil* to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This event marks the beginning of the prophetic mission and is celebrated as the night when divine decree and destiny for the coming year are determined, highlighting the intersection of cosmic fate and spiritual guidance.
